the application of B at the rate of 2kg B ha 1 as soil application along with foliar spray of 0.3 % B at 60 and 75 days after sowing resulted in the highest B uptake and yield in sunflower and green grams, respectively.
soil application of borax at 1.5 kg B ha 2.0kgBha 1) followed by foliar spray of 0.3%B was found to be most effective in increasing the total B uptake by sunflower and green grams.

the development of an efficient, low-cost, environmentally safe, and nonhazardous method for the removal of boron from aqueous solutions.
the effect of boron fertilization on the yield and B uptake of sunflower and the residual effect on green gram grown in Inceptisol.
the effect of boron fertilization in sunflower green gram cropping sequence.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the soil application of boron at a rate of kg B ha 2.5 is recommended for obtaining maximum yield of sunflower in Inceptisolls.

soil application of borax at a rate of kg B ha 0.5 1 was found to be the best among the B fertilizers tested for improving the B nutrition of sunflower and the yield of green gram in Inceptisol soils.

the application of B at the rate of 2 kg ha 1 as a soil application and foliar spray of 0.3 % B solution was found to be most effective in improving the yield of sunflower (Helanthus annuus) and green gram (Vignaradiata).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of B in the soil as well as in the foliar spray is necessary for the optimum yield and B uptake of sunflower.

the use of Agribor as soil application at a rate of l.5 kg B ha 2 is more economical and efficient in terms of B uptake and yield in the cropping sequence of sunflower-green gram in the soils of Tamil Nadu.
borax was more effective for B application to sunflower in Inceptisol than other B sources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of B fertilizers in the form of soil application or foliar spray is beneficial to sunflower crop and the residual effect of soil applied B on green gram crop is also significant.
the B fertilizers are very important for the growth and development of crops, especially in the soils with low B status.
we have shown that the boron fertilizer Agribor, which is a borax based product, can be effectively used to correct the B deficiency in sunflower and green grams.
